Title: TikTok's "Secret Menu" Coffee Orders Have More Sugar Than A Soda

Description:
A dozen pumps of syrup, extra drizzle, two or three flavor shots stacked into one cup - TikTok's "secret menu" coffee orders get millions of views, but one widely covered order was reported to pack in more than 20 teaspoons of added sugar. That's more than a large soda, just dressed up as coffee.

Three things make these drinks worse for blood sugar than people expect: liquid sugar absorbs faster than sugar in solid food, stacked syrup pumps make it easy to lose track of how much you're adding, and caffeine itself can blunt insulin sensitivity for a few hours - so the spike runs higher and lasts longer.

Coffee itself isn't the problem. Ask for sugar-free syrup, cut the pumps in half, swap extra syrup for a splash of milk, and skip ordering it on an empty stomach.
